summary: Independent DAY-shift discovery pass found credible autonomy-regulation and space-infrastructure weak signals, but the cadence-due active gating discovery-family sweep is not yet complete enough to claim acquisitionComplete. Sensor findings remain non-gating and no new company is promoted to canonical membership.

materialFindings.finding: NHTSA opened an Audit Query on Tesla Cybercab self-certification after commercial deployment, reinforcing vehicle certification/regulatory throughput as a potentially distinct autonomy constraint from technical driving capability.

NASA awarded Blue Origin a Mars Telecommunications Network contract with maximum potential value of about $700 million and delivery no later than Dec. 31, 2028. This is a strong private-company signal for deep-space communications/navigation infrastructure and suggests Earth should track Mars/planetary relay networks as a distinct infrastructure dependency even though Blue Origin is not an admission-eligible public-equity candidate today.

NASA added Relativity Space's Terran R to the NLS II launch-services contract on Sept. 9, 2026. This is primary evidence that a next-generation heavy-lift entrant is crossing a government qualification boundary before broad operating history exists; because Relativity is private, treat as a technology/competition watch signal rather than a public-company discovery.

Cboe's 2026 new-listings page currently shows recent visible notices dominated by ETFs/ETPs rather than operating-company additions, so no operating-company challenger was promoted from that source in this pass.

FDA's Sept. 3-9 approvals include first-in-class/accelerated therapies across rare neurologic disease and oncology, confirming continued high regulatory throughput in precision and genetically targeted medicine. These are domain signals only until mapped to active-universe issuers and investment-relevant evidence.

proposedCanonicalChanges.proposal: Evaluate a non-company causal/watch node for deep-space communications relay/navigation infrastructure, using the NASA Mars Telecommunications Network award as primary evidence and adding explicit substitution/falsifier conditions before graph promotion.
Continue the open autonomy-certification directive and test entity-level exposure before treating regulatory throughput as a scored causal constraint.

contradictions.issue: Automated source-health reports 100% health for four required probes, but the discovery contract defines a broader set of cadence-driven gating discovery families. Probe freshness therefore cannot be interpreted as a completed same-cycle discovery sweep.
